gaps.weapon_or_question: Two NEW Astoria weapons added in the final 2026 playtest (Oct 15, 2026). No row, no wiki page.
gaps.why: Every one of the 184 BBG weapon pages and every WeaponLI entry on the 11 class pages has a row. The only uncovered item is the list subpage 'Soldier (BBG)/Weapons', which is skipped. This gap is new content. InstableGR's description for 'Battle Bears Gold - Final PC Playtest (10/15/26)' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HKbwq7PolNc, uploaded Oct 17, 2026) says: "We got skins for Riggs, Wil, and Huggable inspired by the classic games and two new weapons for Astoria" [fan claim; description read through the YouTube innertube 'next' endpoint]. SkyVu's Steam post of Oct 14, 2026 ('Final Discord Playtest this Thursday Oct 15') says: "A lot to test this week, including a couple of surprises we didn't think we'd be able to squeeze in!" [Canon, ISteamNews API for app 4408320]. The wiki has no new page: its recentchanges since Sep 15 show only edits. Astoria footage chapters: Match 2 at 5:14, Match 3 at 9:24 and Match 9 at 35:30 of HKbwq7PolNc. Also JustNubz 'Battle Bears Gold FINAL PLAYTEST' (1MP1rFi4t-Q, Oct 16, 2026, 1:39:07). The thumbnails I opened do not show Astoria, so the weapons' names and looks are [Unverified] (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-thallo-site/91c60972-6d3f-51de-9a92-c1d563bcf5a4/scratchpad/weapons/dl/completeness/frames/yt_HKbwq7PolNc.jpg).
